parsed.name: ai_power_global
parsed.strategy: Bet that the AI capex bottleneck sits in physical infrastructure and the memory it consumes: turbines and grid gear (GEV, VRT, NVT), leading-edge foundry and lithography (TSM, ASML), HBM (MU), plus cash-generative pharma with dated Q4 PDUFA or earnings events (MRK, ABBV, AMGN, ARGX, WST, COGT, VRTX) and uranium (CCJ). Every name has a dated observable inside the six-month window. I would be wrong if hyperscaler capex digestion hits the power/semis sleeve at once, if the Oct 14-15 ASML/TSM prints guide capex down, or if the Q4 PDUFA cluster produces CRLs.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return vs SPY, net of costs, via dated AI power, semis and pharma catalysts.
